chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Woe be to those who oppress the members of my Household! I can see their rank to be the same as the hypocrites in the lowest depths of the Fire.

key_terms.الْوَيْلُ: Woe or destruction (a call to ruin)

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for those who oppress the Prophet's family according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* underscores the high status of the Ahl al-Bayt by linking their oppression to the specific group of hypocrites (*al-Munafiqun*) mentioned in the Quran. It highlights the eschatological consequence for those who wrong the Prophet's family, emphasizing their unique spiritual authority and the severity of divine retribution for their mistreatment.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-177 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “
Woe be to those who oppress the members of my Household! I can see their rank to be the same as the hypocrites in the lowest depths of the Fire.”
